counterparts.name: Download program in the user's network

limits.source: pyLoad-ng: 100 requests a minute per client on /api/* (api_blueprint.py, commit 8939301c, answer HTTP 429); the other programs document no limit and get the same cap. Kept by the call budget (core/call-budget.ts) for every request and every WebSocket handshake; own pace: one query per program at most every 10 s, a first query of up to 8 calls (Deluge login)

own cap: My.JDownloader documents no threshold, only HTTP 429 (Home Assistant asks every 60 s). Kept by the call budget (core/call-budget.ts) for every account at once; the adapter asks at most every 30 s (jdownloader/driver.ts), 3 calls a query; a login with device list and version adds 3 — three starts in one minute with two queries and a new login stay near 28
